scripts.build: pnpm run build:core-api && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload && pnpm run build:preload-docker-extension && pnpm run build:preload-webview && npm run build:preload:types && pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:extensions
scripts.build:extensions: pnpm run build:extensions:compose && pnpm run build:extensions:docker && pnpm run build:extensions:podman-docker-context && pnpm run build:extensions:lima && pnpm run build:extensions:podman && pnpm run build:extensions:kubecontext && pnpm run build:extensions:kind && pnpm run build:extensions:registries && pnpm run build:extensions:kubectl-cli
scripts.compile: cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && electron-builder build --config .electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --config.asar=false
scripts.compile:next: cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && electron-builder build --publish always --config .electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.compile:pull-request: cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && electron-builder build --publish never --config .electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.compile:current: cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && electron-builder build --config .electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:build: playwright install chromium && cross-env NODE_ENV=development MODE=development DEBUG=pw:browser pnpm run build
scripts.test:e2e:all: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:all:run
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:smoke:run
scripts.test:e2e:k8s: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:k8s:run
scripts.test:e2e:k8s-sanity: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:k8s-sanity:run
scripts.test:e2e:windows-sanity: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:windows-sanity:run
scripts.test:e2e:macos-sanity: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:macos-sanity:run
scripts.test:e2e:pdmachine: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:pdmachine:run

scripts.test:e2e:experimental: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:experimental:run
scripts.test:e2e:extension: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:extension:run
scripts.test:e2e:remote: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:remote:run
scripts.test:e2e:update: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:update:run
scripts.test:e2e:ui-stress: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:ui-stress:run
scripts.test:e2e:screenshots: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:screenshots:run
scripts.test:e2e:managed-configuration: pnpm run test:e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e:managed-configuration:run

scripts.test:renderer: pnpm run build:preload:types && pnpm run build:ui && vitest --run --project=renderer --passWithNoTests
scripts.typecheck:ui: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:preload:types && svelte-check --tsconfig packages/ui/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:extensions: pnpm run typecheck:extensions:compose && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:kind && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:docker && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:podman-docker-context && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:lima && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:kube-context && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:podman && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:registries && pnpm run typecheck:extensions:kubectl-cli

scripts.website:build: pnpm run storybook:build && cd website && pnpm run docusaurus clear && pnpm run docusaurus build --no-minify
scripts.website:prod: pnpm run website:build && cd website/build && pnpm serve
scripts.website:dev: pnpm run storybook:build && cd website && pnpm run docusaurus start
scripts.generate:schemas: pnpm run generate:schemas:extension && biome format --write schemas/
scripts.storybook:dev: pnpm run storybook:css && pnpm --filter storybook dev
scripts.storybook:build: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run storybook:css && cd storybook && pnpm run build
